text.description_html:
Bommer 1011, 4" Full Surface Brushed Chrome Single Acting Spring Hinges

Bommer Lavatory Door Spring Hinges are packaged complete with a Pair (2) Single Action Spring Door Hinges, Tension Adjusting Tool, Locking Pins plus 1/4-20 x 3/4" machine screws. It has a Brushed Chrome finish.

These full surface spring hinges are normally used on restroom stall doors. Full Surface Hinge - Jamb flange is surface applied to door jamb. Door flange is surface applied to door face.

The included Tension Tool is use to adjust spring tension. The Locking Pins hold the Spring in tension after it is set. These adjustable tension spring hinges allow you to determine how much closing force you apply to the door (how hard/fast the door self closes).

Specifications for Bommer 1011 Lavatory Door Spring Hinge

  • Finish: Brushed Chrome
  • Height: 4.124"
  • Width: 4.124"
  • Corners: Radius
  • Gauge of Metal: .109
  • Hinge Material: Heavy Duty Brass Casting
  • Adjustable Spring Torque
  • Non-Handed
  • Full Surface
  • Bommer 1011 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Available with or with out Hold Open option (Holds door in open position).

Sold as a pair (2 Hinges).
